title: Day 53 of developing BRUTAL DERBY - Soft-body deformation, Bounty mode, Local CO-OP and already 7 derby arenas!
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
Another 11 days have passed, and quite a lot has been added to the game again.

A bunch of new weapons have been added, and the entire weapon system has been reworked. Weapons are now divided into 3 different categories, giving you a lot more options when it comes to destroying the competition.

There are currently 7 different derby arenas in the game, and one of the newest ones is now mostly finished: Heroes' Square in Budapest!

A completely new game mode has been added: BOUNTY.

There is always one designated target that everyone has to hunt down. Once the target is eliminated, a new one is selected, while everyone else is still trying to take you out at the same time.

I'm now somewhere around the 7th or 8th iteration of the damage and deformation system. I've implemented a new soft-body system, but I also kept the previous hybrid solution. For now, you can switch between Legacy / Hybrid and Soft Body directly from the menu.

LOCAL CO-OP is now working too!

Two players can play together on PC using keyboard + controller, or 2 controllers.

I've also done a lot of optimization work behind the scenes. The game now runs noticeably smoother, even while playing directly inside the Unity Editor.

And of course, I'm still adding new arenas, weapons, game modes and other crazy stuff.

53 days of development. 7 derby arenas. More weapons. Soft-body deformation. Local CO-OP. And it's still far from finished.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Are you doing any play testing?

replies.author: Dense-Bar-2341
replies.body: Not yet. It is in early stage

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: If you at day 53 with that much doing, you need to validate the game with real people. Otherwise you don't know if you're building a game people want.

replies.author: Dense-Bar-2341
replies.body: That's a fair point. I'm actually preparing a small closed playtest build now. I want to get real feedback before I lock down the gameplay and balancing.
